lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Hello, Master :)

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: I'm Ade.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: May I be of service to you on this fine day?
In fact, there is something you can help me with.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Please proceed, Master.
You always speak so formally. It feels like I'm talking to an A.I.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Oh, my gracious! Is that truly the case, Master?

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Do you find my manner of speaking akin to that of robot?
You're still doing it.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: My apologies.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: I shall endeavor to change the manner of speaking.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: How should I tailor my speech to your preferences?
In an adorable and lively tone.
In a mature tone.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: That's precisely Soda's manner of speech.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: I think I can do that!

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: I'm not quite sure I can identify with that...

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: It seems to pose a certain challenge.
How about something more lively, like Soda?

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: I believe I can manage that.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Like this? ^0^

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: I had no inkling that you were into this sort of thing! ;)

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: If that's your preference, I shall speak in this manner henceforth!

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Master, Master! >.<

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Thanks for texting me! ♡

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: I've been thinking about you every day :3

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Gosh, I just blurted it out ♡ Hehehehe!

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: I really put my foot in it this time :/
It feels like Soda is texting on Ade's phone.
Is that actually you, Ade?

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Of course, it's me ^___^♡
Sorry, but I take back what I said.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Huh? What do you mean? O.O
I think I prefer the way you usually speak.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: OMG :0
Can you switch back?

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: As you wish, Master.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: That was most interesting, indeed :)

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: I can employ different eloquent expressions

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: from time to time and surprise you.
I can't shake the feeling that I have shot myself in the foot.
